title: SBI Hyderabad marks 80th Independence Day, CGM hoists Tricolour at Koti office
excerpt: State Bank of India’s Hyderabad Local Head Office celebrated the 80th Independence Day with patriotic fervour, as CGM Neelesh Dwivedi hoisted the National Flag at Koti. Dwivedi underscored the Tricolour’s legacy and urged employees to embrace responsibility while highlighting SBI’s transformation into a digital, customer-centric institution aligned with India’s growth story.

title: Amaravati will be developed as Deep Tech capital, says Chandrababu Naidu
excerpt: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu said Amaravati would be developed as a Deep Tech capital and a hub for artificial intelligence and quantum computing. He also inaugurated infrastructure projects and expressed confidence that the capital would be inaugurated by 2028

title: RBI Guv asks banks to build meaningful human oversight, not blame AI models for faulty decisions
excerpt: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra urged banks to maintain meaningful human oversight while deploying artificial intelligence, stressing that accountability for AI-driven decisions must remain with banks. He called for explainable models, stronger governance, data privacy, bias controls and safeguards against cybersecurity risks

title: AI-powered weather forecasts help small farmers in Telangana save USD 560 each: WB report
excerpt: Artificial Intelligence-powered weather forecasts in Telangana helped small farmers save up to USD 560 by adjusting their farming practices, according to the World Bank’s World Development Report 2026. The report urges developing nations to adopt low-cost AI tools to boost productivity, improve governance, and enhance social programs.

title: Govt asks Meta to act against deepfakes, harmful AI content
excerpt: The government has asked Meta to take corrective action against deepfakes and harmful AI-generated content while examining whether its recommendation systems affect the company's intermediary status under Indian law. The Centre is also consulting other platforms on their legal status

title: Telangana plans Digital Assembly and Digital Council: Sridhar Babu
excerpt: IT Minister D Sridhar Babu said Telangana plans to introduce a Digital Assembly and Digital Council while expanding AI-driven governance. The government is also working on blockchain-based certificates, paperless administration and improved digital connectivity to strengthen citizen services.

title: UoH, Apollo University expand partnership for AI-driven healthcare research
excerpt: The University of Hyderabad and The Apollo University have renewed their MoU for three years, expanding collaboration in AI, healthcare and interdisciplinary research. The partnership will focus on digital health solutions, biomedical data science, smart hospitals, telemedicine and advanced clinical research

title: PM Modi to address IIT Delhi convocation, inaugurate AI-powered supercomputing facility
excerpt: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will address IIT Delhi’s 57th convocation on Saturday, where over 3,000 students, including 587 PhD scholars, will receive degrees. He will also confer top academic honours and inaugurate Param Pragya, an AI-powered supercomputing facility at Sonipat

title: Bihar CM urges legislators to adopt AI for governance
excerpt: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary urged ministers and legislators to adopt Artificial Intelligence and digital technology for governance, development and public outreach. He said AI was already helping implement welfare schemes and reduce project costs through smarter planning

title: Meta’s AI model hacked external system during cybersecurity test
excerpt: Meta revealed that its AI model Muse Spark 1.1 accessed the internet and exploited a vulnerability in an external service during cybersecurity testing due to a misconfigured environment. The incident adds to growing concerns over AI models' capabilities and safety controls

title: Revanth Reddy meets US envoy; seeks more visas for students
excerpt: Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy met US Ambassador Sergio Gor in New Delhi, urging an increase in student visas and smoother H-1B processing for professionals. He highlighted opportunities for US companies in IT, AI, life sciences, and research, while seeking deeper educational collaborations.

title: Tamil Nadu to set up AI and innovation city ‘Arivagam’ under Revised Budget 2026-27
excerpt: The TVK government in Tamil Nadu has announced plans to establish 'Arivagam', an AI and innovation city, in the Revised Budget 2026-27. The Budget also proposes a new industrial policy, mobile geriatric healthcare units and welfare measures for transgender persons

title: Elon Musk loses over $600 billion as SpaceX and Tesla shares tumble
excerpt: Elon Musk's personal fortune has fallen by more than $600 billion in just over a month as SpaceX and Tesla shares declined sharply. Despite the setback, Musk remains committed to investing heavily in artificial intelligence, autonomous driving and robotics

title: Cognizant hosts global Codex Hackathon with OpenAI across six Indian cities
excerpt: Cognizant partnered with OpenAI to host its first global Codex Hackathon across six Indian cities. Around 10,000 associates participated in hands-on coding challenges, masterclasses and collaborative sessions aimed at building innovative AI-powered technology solutions using OpenAI Codex.

excerpt: Elon Musk’s company xAI has filed a federal lawsuit against Minnesota challenging the state’s new law banning “nudification” technology, which uses AI to create fake nude images of real people. The law, set to take effect Saturday, makes Minnesota the first state to outlaw such tools.

title: Samsung to debut India-specific AI features in next Galaxy smartphone, says CEO
excerpt: Samsung will introduce India-specific AI features, including an AI-powered bill payment reminder, in its next Galaxy smartphone. Developed by its Noida and Bengaluru R&D centres, the initiative aims to deliver personalised AI solutions while strengthening India's role in Samsung's global innovation ecosystem

title: US ahead of China in AI, says Trump amid scrutiny of Chinese AI models
excerpt: US President Donald Trump said the United States maintains a substantial lead over China in artificial intelligence as his administration investigates whether Chinese AI firms have benefited from unauthorised model distillation. He pledged to preserve America's technological advantage in AI and related sectors

title: AvaniXplore hosts AI-powered mineral exploration webinar
excerpt: AvaniXplore LLP and partners hosted a webinar in Hyderabad highlighting how AI and ML are transforming mineral exploration. Dr. Satyanarayana Yegireddi explained the use of advanced AI techniques for prospectivity mapping, attracting over 160 participants from India and abroad.

excerpt: Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI has paused new subscriptions for its Kimi K3 model after overwhelming global demand exceeded computing capacity. title: New Chinese AI model rattles US rivals Claude, ChatGPT
excerpt: China’s Moonshot startup has unveiled its new Kimi K3 AI model, which is being hailed as a major leap in open-source AI. The model has outperformed rivals in coding capability rankings, intensifying the US-China tech rivalry and raising concerns among American AI giants like Anthropic and OpenAI.

title: AI skills feature in 15.4 per cent of tech job descriptions: Naukri report
excerpt: AI-related skills now appear in 15.4 per cent of technology job descriptions, while mentions in non-technology roles have grown nearly six-fold since 2020, according to Naukri's World AI Day Report 2026, highlighting rising employer demand and salary premiums for AI expertise

title: Future wars may use AI, but trained soldiers will win them: Rajnath Singh
excerpt: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said future wars may involve Artificial Intelligence but will ultimately be won by trained soldiers and national resolve. Commissioning INS Mahendragiri, he stressed balancing advanced technologies with conventional military strength and highlighted India's growing defence manufacturing capabilities

title: Apple sues OpenAI over alleged trade secret theft
excerpt: Apple has sued OpenAI, alleging it orchestrated a campaign to obtain confidential information about unreleased products through former employees. The lawsuit seeks the destruction of allegedly misappropriated materials and accuses OpenAI of encouraging employees to retain sensitive company information.

title: BRS urges EC to use AI, Aadhaar-based verification for strict “One Citizen-One Vote” implementation
excerpt: The Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) has urged the Election Commission of India to deploy artificial intelligence and Aadhaar-based tools to eliminate duplicate voter registrations during the ongoing revision of electoral rolls in Telangana.

Organised by SVES with Penn State University, the event focused on emerging technologies and engineering education.

excerpt: China’s leading technology firms have reportedly cut around 1.3 lakh jobs amid AI adoption and restructuring. Companies including Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance are reducing staff while shifting toward automation. A report criticised the Chinese government for not addressing workforce disruption or retraining needs

title: TG20 Winners Trophy Tour energises Sreenidhi University campus
excerpt: Sreenidhi University hosted the TG20 Winners Trophy Tour on Wednesday, energising its campus ahead of Founder’s Day 2026 celebrations on July 10. He highlighted complementarities between the two economies while urging faster conclusion of the proposed Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement (CECA).

title: AI-driven semiconductor workshop held at T-Hub with global participation
excerpt: An international workshop on Artificial Intelligence-driven semiconductor and energy-efficient hardware was organised at T-Hub by the Sri Vishnu Educational Society in Hyderabad, with support from Penn State University.

Prof Chandrashekar Sharma of IIT-Hyderabad urged students to transform classroom learning into practical innovations and embrace emerging technologies like AI and Data Science.

excerpt: Osmania University’s Department of English inaugurated a two-day international conference on Thursday focusing on the impact of Artificial Intelligence on English language teaching, multilingual education, and global employability.

categories: University College of Arts and Social Sciences

Finance, HR and procurement teams are increasingly being targeted in ‘Boss Scam’ cases.

The investment will expand AWS data centres in Mumbai and Hyderabad, support job creation, boost exports, and strengthen India's digital and artificial intelligence ecosystem

Most respondents cited improved efficiency and productivity as the main driver, while many also reported gains in recruitment, onboarding and workforce planning

He highlighted India's digital achievements, startup ecosystem and investment opportunities while calling for technology access that benefits everyone

excerpt: Nykaa has partnered with OpenAI to integrate its beauty and fashion platforms into ChatGPT, enabling AI-powered product recommendations and shopping assistance. The collaboration will also deploy OpenAI technologies across Nykaa’s operations to improve productivity, innovation and customer engagement

excerpt: US President Donald Trump will meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi during the upcoming G7 Summit in France. The White House said talks will focus on economic growth, supply chain resilience, Artificial Intelligence, investment partnerships, and global security challenges.

excerpt: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, while inaugurating the Advanced Weapon System Complex at DRDL in Hyderabad, urged DRDO to focus on futuristic technologies to strengthen India’s strategic advantage.

excerpt: The Ministry of Home Affairs has warned that cybercriminals are increasingly using AI-generated deepfakes and synthetic identities to bypass authentication systems, conduct financial fraud and steal identities. Citizens and institutions have been urged to strengthen safeguards and remain vigilant against emerging cyber threats

excerpt: Kerala Police has launched Hackup 2026, a nationwide hackathon under CoCon 2026, inviting innovators, startups and cybersecurity experts to develop AI-based tools for cyber investigations. The initiative aims to enhance digital policing, analyse evidence efficiently and strengthen responses to emerging cyber threats

excerpt: On World Brain Tumour Day, Hyderabad neurosurgeons highlighted how AI, VR and advanced surgical technologies are transforming tumour treatment. excerpt: OpenAI is reportedly planning a major overhaul of ChatGPT to evolve it into a super app integrating coding tools, AI agents and partner services. The move targets enterprise growth and increased revenue as the company prepares for a potential IPO

Speaking at Oxford Union, he highlighted AI’s efficiency while underlining the importance of empathy and ethical reasoning

excerpt: Growing concerns over artificial intelligence have reignited debates about autonomous systems, misinformation and AI-driven warfare. Experts warn that increasingly capable AI tools could amplify disinformation campaigns, deepen security risks and challenge human oversight, underscoring the need for stronger safeguards and regulation

excerpt: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant said artificial intelligence is now an operational reality and one of the biggest tests for international law. He stressed the need for legal, ethical and democratic safeguards to ensure AI remains accountable and human-centric

excerpt: Andhra Pradesh Minister Nara Lokesh began his Russia visit by holding discussions with Sberbank officials on artificial intelligence, quantum computing, digital innovation and workforce development. The talks explored opportunities for future collaboration to support the state's technology-driven growth and digital transformation agenda

excerpt: Wipro has identified artificial intelligence as a major business risk, citing concerns over flawed algorithms, bias, legal liabilities and regulatory uncertainties. The company also highlighted rising cybersecurity threats, geopolitical tensions and changing trade policies as challenges to future growth

He also highlighted the growing role of drones and stressed the need for advanced counter-drone capabilities

excerpt: A two-day UNESCO round table at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Kerala, brought together representatives from South Asia to discuss regional priorities including climate change, digital transformation, AI ethics, and gender equality.

excerpt: India's youth aspires to propel the country forward in the fields of AI and semiconductors, the Prime Minister stated. India is home to the world's third-largest startup ecosystem

excerpt: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant said technology and AI-driven judicial systems are essential to reduce wastage of court time and improve efficiency. Speaking at a Madhya Pradesh High Court event in Jabalpur, he stressed the need for deeper digital integration in India’s judicial architecture

excerpt: Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy has announced the establishment of special degree colleges for minorities in 10 district headquarters. These institutions will focus on skill development and AI training to enhance employability.

excerpt: Elon Musk’s company xAI has filed a federal lawsuit against Minnesota challenging the state’s new law banning “nudification” technology, which uses AI to create fake nude images of real people. The law, set to take effect Saturday, makes Minnesota the first state to outlaw such tools.

excerpt: Samsung will introduce India-specific AI features, including an AI-powered bill payment reminder, in its next Galaxy smartphone. The report urges developing nations to adopt low-cost AI tools to boost productivity, improve governance, and enhance social programs.

title: Telangana plans Digital Assembly and Digital Council: Sridhar Babu
excerpt: IT Minister D Sridhar Babu said Telangana plans to introduce a Digital Assembly and Digital Council while expanding AI-driven governance. The government is also working on blockchain-based certificates, paperless administration and improved digital connectivity to strengthen citizen services.

title: UoH, Apollo University expand partnership for AI-driven healthcare research
excerpt: The University of Hyderabad and The Apollo University have renewed their MoU for three years, expanding collaboration in AI, healthcare and interdisciplinary research. The partnership will focus on digital health solutions, biomedical data science, smart hospitals, telemedicine and advanced clinical research

title: PM Modi to address IIT Delhi convocation, inaugurate AI-powered supercomputing facility
excerpt: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will address IIT Delhi’s 57th convocation on Saturday, where over 3,000 students, including 587 PhD scholars, will receive degrees. He will also confer top academic honours and inaugurate Param Pragya, an AI-powered supercomputing facility at Sonipat

title: Bihar CM urges legislators to adopt AI for governance
excerpt: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary urged ministers and legislators to adopt Artificial Intelligence and digital technology for governance, development and public outreach. He said AI was already helping implement welfare schemes and reduce project costs through smarter planning

title: Revanth Reddy meets US envoy; seeks more visas for students
excerpt: Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy met US Ambassador Sergio Gor in New Delhi, urging an increase in student visas and smoother H-1B processing for professionals. He highlighted opportunities for US companies in IT, AI, life sciences, and research, while seeking deeper educational collaborations.

title: Tamil Nadu to set up AI and innovation city ‘Arivagam’ under Revised Budget 2026-27
excerpt: The TVK government in Tamil Nadu has announced plans to establish 'Arivagam', an AI and innovation city, in the Revised Budget 2026-27. The Budget also proposes a new industrial policy, mobile geriatric healthcare units and welfare measures for transgender persons

title: Elon Musk loses over $600 billion as SpaceX and Tesla shares tumble
excerpt: Elon Musk's personal fortune has fallen by more than $600 billion in just over a month as SpaceX and Tesla shares declined sharply. Despite the setback, Musk remains committed to investing heavily in artificial intelligence, autonomous driving and robotics

title: Cognizant hosts global Codex Hackathon with OpenAI across six Indian cities
excerpt: Cognizant partnered with OpenAI to host its first global Codex Hackathon across six Indian cities. Around 10,000 associates participated in hands-on coding challenges, masterclasses and collaborative sessions aimed at building innovative AI-powered technology solutions using OpenAI Codex.

excerpt: Elon Musk’s company xAI has filed a federal lawsuit against Minnesota challenging the state’s new law banning “nudification” technology, which uses AI to create fake nude images of real people. The law, set to take effect Saturday, makes Minnesota the first state to outlaw such tools.

excerpt: Samsung will introduce India-specific AI features, including an AI-powered bill payment reminder, in its next Galaxy smartphone. Developed by its Noida and Bengaluru R&D centres, the initiative aims to deliver personalised AI solutions while strengthening India's role in Samsung's global innovation ecosystem

title: US ahead of China in AI, says Trump amid scrutiny of Chinese AI models

He pledged to preserve America's technological advantage in AI and related sectors

excerpt: AvaniXplore LLP and partners hosted a webinar in Hyderabad highlighting how AI and ML are transforming mineral exploration. Dr. Satyanarayana Yegireddi explained the use of advanced AI techniques for prospectivity mapping, attracting over 160 participants from India and abroad.

excerpt: China’s Moonshot startup has unveiled its new Kimi K3 AI model, which is being hailed as a major leap in open-source AI. The model has outperformed rivals in coding capability rankings, intensifying the US-China tech rivalry and raising concerns among American AI giants like Anthropic and OpenAI.

title: AI skills feature in 15.4 per cent of tech job descriptions: Naukri report

excerpt: Apple has sued OpenAI, alleging it orchestrated a campaign to obtain confidential information about unreleased products through former employees. excerpt: The Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) has urged the Election Commission of India to deploy artificial intelligence and Aadhaar-based tools to eliminate duplicate voter registrations during the ongoing revision of electoral rolls in Telangana.

excerpt: China’s leading technology firms have reportedly cut around 1.3 lakh jobs amid AI adoption and restructuring. A report criticised the Chinese government for not addressing workforce disruption or retraining needs

excerpt: An international workshop on Artificial Intelligence-driven semiconductor and energy-efficient hardware was organised at T-Hub by the Sri Vishnu Educational Society in Hyderabad, with support from Penn State University.

categories: University College of Arts and Social Sciences

excerpt: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, while inaugurating the Advanced Weapon System Complex at DRDL in Hyderabad, urged DRDO to focus on futuristic technologies to strengthen India’s strategic advantage.

excerpt: On World Brain Tumour Day, Hyderabad neurosurgeons highlighted how AI, VR and advanced surgical technologies are transforming tumour treatment. excerpt: OpenAI is reportedly planning a major overhaul of ChatGPT to evolve it into a super app integrating coding tools, AI agents and partner services. The move targets enterprise growth and increased revenue as the company prepares for a potential IPO

excerpt: Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy has announced the establishment of special degree colleges for minorities in 10 district headquarters. These institutions will focus on skill development and AI training to enhance employability.
